articles.summary: Acquisition includes LAM-001, an inhaled formulation of rapamycin for multiple pulmonary diseases, including pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and bronchiolitis obliterans syndrome post lung transplant (BOS) $115 million in upfront financing with the
articles.title: Quince Announces Acquisition of Orphai and up to $187 Million Private Placement to Advance Pulmonary Pipeline

articles.summary: Data from Phase 2a study of LAM-001 on top of standard of care in PH-ILD patients with refractory PH demonstrated clinically meaningful improvement in multiple assessments of lung function, including improvement in 6MWD of 67.4 meters and PVR reduction of 33.9% at 24 weeks Phase 2b trial in PH-ILD
articles.title: Quince Therapeutics Announces Clinically Meaningful Improvements Across Functional, Hemodynamic and Biomarker Measures in Phase 2 Study in PAH and PH-ILD
